headline: Lorde says AI glasses are 'not sexy', urging fans to avoid them due to privacy concerns
summary: Pop star Lorde publicly denounced Meta's AI glasses at a festival, calling them "not sexy" and a privacy nightmare, despite the product's strong sales and festival sponsorship ties.
details: At the Mad Cool Festival in Madrid, pop star Lorde delivered a strong critique of Meta's AI glasses, telling the audience to "f*** the glasses" and "Don't get the glasses. Not sexy." Her comments highlighted growing concerns about the technology.

Lorde emphasized the difficulty in discerning reality with such devices, echoing sentiments from security experts who deem AI glasses a "privacy nightmare." She has previously expressed anti-tech sentiments, including throwing her phone into the ocean.

Her remarks were particularly notable as Ray-Ban, a partner with Meta on the AI glasses, was a festival sponsor. Additionally, singer Jennie, an ambassador for Ray-Ban Meta's smart glasses, performed immediately after Lorde.

Despite privacy investigations and lawsuits alleging misuse, Meta AI glasses have seen significant commercial success. EssilorLuxottica, Ray-Ban's maker, reported selling over 7 million Meta AI glasses in 2025, tripling sales from 2023 and 2024 combined.
